targets.title: Erdos Problem #886 — divisors near the square root
targets.prompt: Audit and make rigorous progress on Erdős problem #886, concerning divisors close to the square root, using the exact current statement at https://www.erdosproblems.com/886. Retrieve the exact quantifiers and verify current primary results, especially the sharp role of the n^(1/4) window, before working. Test boundary cases and false extrapolations, independently certify every retained finite calculation, and distinguish any defect in a cited proposition from progress on the original open problem. Do not claim a solution or novelty unless every obligation of the exact unrestricted problem and the dated literature gap is closed.

audit_suffix: CANDIDATE AUDIT GATE: Work with the selected harness and model only. Once a substantial candidate argument, central lemma, construction, or source-based claim exists, you MUST read `_agent/skills/research-proof-audit/SKILL.md` completely and follow it before finalizing. Read only the task-relevant referenced files it names. Freeze the exact statement and candidate, run independent global and decomposed audits, add the refuter pass for any proposed solution, and preserve disagreements and failed checks. A file-capable harness MUST write its individual and merged audit artifacts under `audit/<run-id>/`; if fresh-context delegation is unavailable, run isolated serial passes and record degraded independence. End proof.md with exactly one explicit line in the form `ProvingConsole outcome: <label>`, where `<label>` is Solved, Counterexample, Known/Open Status, or Partial Progress. An audit accept verdict alone is not Solved.
baseline_suffix: CONTROL CONDITION: Use the harness's normal rigorous workflow without invoking the research-proof-audit skill. Still preserve reproducible evidence and end proof.md with exactly one ProvingConsole outcome: Solved, Counterexample, Known/Open Status, or Partial Progress.
